lines.t: (Verse 1)
I found a little pickle, green and oh so bright,
Thought I'd make a snack, maybe take a bite.
But then I had a thought that made me giggle tickle,
"If you pickle a pickle, it becomes a pickled pickle!" (Chorus)
Oh, pickle, pickle, you’re the king of the crop,
Every crunch’s a punch, bye, with a pickle on top!
In a jar or on a burger, you just never stop,
Say goodbye with a pickle, yeah, with a pickle on top! (Verse 2)
Some like 'em sweet, some like 'em sour,
Pickles bring the party, hour by hour.
With mustard or on sandwiches, they're never fickle,
Remember what I say: a pickled pickle! (Chorus)
Oh, pickle, pickle, you’re the king of the crop,
Every crunch’s a punch, bye, with a pickle on top!
